body:
### Summary

Currently it seems like all workspace members must be inside workspace root directory, maybe, cause when i try to add a member outside of workspace root it seems like that member can't find the workspace root and fails to find a workspace dependency

Maybe an environment variable could be added to 

### Example

```
example
  a
    pyproject.toml
  b
    pyproject.toml
```

```
# a/pyproject.toml
[project]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.14"
dependencies = []

[tool.uv.workspace]
members = [
    "../b"
]

[build-system]
requires = ["uv_build>=0.12.3,<0.13.0"]
build-backend = "uv_build"
```

```
# b/pyproject.toml
[project]
name = "b"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.14"
dependencies = ["a"]

[tool.uv.sources]
a = { workspace = true }

[build-system]
requires = ["uv_build>=0.12.3,<0.13.0"]
build-backend = "uv_build"
```
title: Allow for workspace members outside of workspace root
